input.prompt:
Session 126 registered five new fleet roles in src/fleet/mod.rs. Propose what this session's demo script (scripts/demo-session-126.sh) must show.

Context you need to gather yourself (read-only):
- Read src/fleet/mod.rs to see exactly which five roles were registered this session and how roles are represented (the roster, any SIZE constant, role definitions).
- Look at prior demo scripts in scripts/ (e.g. scripts/demo-session-*.sh) to match the house format for demo scripts — header, per-case blocks, a summary table, and before-and-after.
- Recent commits this session: "S126 1/N: register the last five fleet roles", "S126 2/N: scaffold the analyst/design/implementation role definitions", "S126 3/N: scaffold the demo/release role definitions", "S126 4/N: unpin the S121 roster SIZE so a ninth role is not a defect".

Produce the demo brief: the header line, the ordered list of cases the demo must run (each with what it proves), the summary table columns/rows, and the before-and-after contrast. The goal is that the QA gate's live re-run of this script proves what actually shipped this session. Do not write the script — only propose what it must show.
